reviews.x: The teeth broke off the combs BEFORE taking them out of their individually packaged. these combs are garbage. After one dip in barbercide the white number wore off. Do not waste your money, these combs are NOT worth it.

Absolute worst ever. They're incredibly thin, extremely lightweight and the teeth can draw blood at any given moment. I've been a licensed hair stylist for 14+ years now so to say I've grown picky to tools I like to use would be an under statement. I thought I'd give these a try since I have other carbon combs I love and these are the biggest waste of money. They're in the trash can as we speak. (Didn't return because I already tossed packaging and used 2 of them in the salon)

reviews.t: Great combs/ edited for recent purchase
reviews.x: I have bought these twice now, they are the standard comb size. I know some stylists like larger combs but I have pretty small hands and these are comfortable. They do hold up to heat. I haven’t had any combs melt of break. The white lettering does come off in barbicide like another reviewer posted, but I personally don’t care about the lettering. I have had my first order for a while now and they unfortunately keep going missing so apparently my coworkers like them as well. I have flat ironed h

Works perfect for what I had in mind. I have a relatively short beard and mustache and this comb is great without being too flimsy. I can also use it for the little hair left on my head plus it would be great for giving haircuts also.

This is the perfect comb for parting and styling,not so much for combing! I broke 2 combs where the two sides meet on the same client and his hair isn't course at all. Out side of that it's the perfect

reviews.t: NOT carbon fiber but My Favorite comb for parting & cutting despite needed improvements
reviews.x: Absolutely love and I've purchased many kinds. Great for sectioning / parting. Sturdy and durable. Only improvements I suggest would be heat resistant bc these are NOT and possibly putting numbered ruler for cutting on backside instead of holes. Holes have no purpose since they are not evenly distributed across so you cannot measure when cutting.  I still love the comb and it is my every day cutting comb, parting comb and my first choice overall as a cos student. I'd pay a little extra for TRUE

I am now switching all my cutting/drying combs to these. They hold up great against the blow dryer heat, they are the right size for small job and big jobs, the wide tooth at each end makes sectioning east and they are affordable enough to stock an entire salon. Great product.
These are exactly what I wanted. I'm a Barber and I go through combs like crazy.. These are sturdy and work perfect for cutting with.

reviews.t: Not for super thick or tangled!
reviews.x: The teeth break with any resistance.. WOULd NOT RECOMMEND TO USE ON A MANNEQUIN..  but for fine/thin hair they work great
become soft and brittle after soaking them in barbicide. Become useless at that point.

I’m a cosmetology student and also I do here at home I do a ton of braids and whether I am doing braids are doing a silk press or just simply parting the hair especially with my OCD these are my go to combs I’ve gotten compliments on them from other stylus I love them they are heat resistant they’re sturdy they last long and I will truly love the fact that it makes partying very satisfying! must have!!!!

Not carbon combs!  Soft plastic garbage!  Do not order!!!!  They are labeled Toni and Guy and are obviously leftovers from a comb giveaway.  If you are a stylist, I am warning you that these are useless, awkwardly sized pieces of garbage.  I wouldn't give them to my homeless clients.

These were purchased as “extras” for my state board cosmetology exam. When they arrived they were good quality and individually wrapped Toni & Guy combs. I graduated from TG and did not receive these combs in my school kit. Happy with the purchase. Good length for cutting.

I'm a beauty industry professional.  I'm also picky about my tools.  I found these combs to be kind of stiff feeling.  They just don't feel nice or comfortable in my hand.  They are just a standard comb without much or any flex to it.  Just doesn't meet my standards.

reviews.t: Can't go wronf for the price
reviews.x: I like the close sitting teeth of the one side of the comb, I use it to comb and train my beard as it is growing. Can't go wrong for the price and the amount of combs you receive.  They are not very flexible so don't try and bend them too far.

This is a fantastic comb, by far the best comb I have ever used.  Instead of tearing the hair out when the hair snarls the comb smoothly separates it.  I will never need another comb but if I do I will be buying another set of these combs.

I've been looking for a good version of the carbon fiber comb that was a great deal and also had more than one comb in it incase I lost any. THIS WAS THE ONE!! They are lightweight, easy to hold, and they are excellent quality as well.
Just ordered these columns best comes to cut with the hairdresser for 25 years tried these cones out yesterday and they did very well no static no burn
I’m a professional hairdresser, and I prefer a sturdier comb. But for the average user, I’m sure these would be fine. Price is great.
I like notches on each end and I also like the little holes that indicate inches down the spine of the comb.

reviews.t: DO NOT BUY - Not a quality product!
reviews.x: Packaged in Toni & Guy packaging, knock-off YS Park design and definitely not a carbon comb!!!!
These might be carbon coated, but they are not carbon combs.
Teeth break very easily— not good for professional use

reviews.t: Soooo....these aren't the Toni n Guy ones anymore
reviews.x: I've ordered from this company a couple times or more now. This is the first time I was sent a diff quality. The comb barely gets into the hair without force. Today I was doing a client and I was having a hard time parting and combing the hair during the haircut. Like what??? I knew something was off considering the combs came packaged in a box instead of the individual slips as usual! I'm pissed!

These combs are great for fine hair as they are very thin. I've worked with them for a week since purchase (at a salon) and they're quite tiny in the hand. It's all about preference, but in case you like a solid comb that isn't going to poke/scrape clients, it's not my favorite. I do like that it has dots for measuring and is heat resistant...will keep for my fine hair girls.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the combs sturdy, durable, and good value, especially for cutting, sectioning, and beard use.
Several reviewers report the teeth break easily, including before use or with any resistance.
Some reviewers say the combs are not heat resistant or become soft and brittle after soaking in barbicide.
A few reviewers describe the combs as stiff, thin, lightweight, or lacking flexibility.
Some reviewers note the white lettering/numbering wears off in barbicide.
